resources.string: Make an encrypted copy, or bring your files back from a backup.
Pick up where you left off
Your file choices and location are kept. Your recovery number stays private and may need to be entered again.
Your first backup starts with choosing a few files. You can restore it on another phone with its recovery number.
Backups created or successfully restored with this app appear here. Find a backup to open one copied from another device.
No backups here yet. Create one from Home, or find an existing .petalbak file.
Not available here. It may have moved, storage may be disconnected, or access may have expired. Use Find a backup to locate it again.

Each backup is unlocked with the 16-digit number used to create it. You can choose your own number or generate one. Keep it somewhere you can reach without this phone. No Petal or Google account is needed. This app does not save the number.
Notify me when an operation finishes
Notifications let you follow progress outside the app and return to the result. Operations can still run if you decline notification access.

The app needs temporary space on this phone to encrypt and check files, even when the backup is saved elsewhere. File sizes from some storage providers are unavailable; space is also checked while processing.
Checks encryption and restoration using a tiny sample file. Your own files are not used.
What would you like to keep?
Choose a .petalbak file from this phone, removable storage, or a connected document provider.
Add up to 256 individual files. You can add more or remove items before continuing.
This file could not be read as a supported Petal backup. Choose the original .petalbak file or try another copy.
This is an older password-based backup. You will need its original password.
This backup uses a 16-digit recovery number. Its contents will be checked during restoration.
No files selected yet. Tap Add files to browse.

resources.string: Cannot read this item. Remove it or choose it again.
Choose a parent folder. Restored files will go into a new folder inside it, without replacing existing files.
Choose where to save your encrypted .petalbak file. You can change its name in the file picker.
Enter the recovery number or original password for the backup you selected.
Choose a recovery number for this backup, or generate one below.
16 digits, shown as four groups. Pasted spaces and hyphens are accepted.
Older backups use their original text password, including any spaces.
Keep the recovery number somewhere outside this backup. You will need it to restore your files, including on another phone.
Your choices are still here. Enter the recovery number again to continue.
Recovery number or password entered. It will not be saved by this app.
A new restore folder will be created. Existing files will not be overwritten.
Temporary space available on this phone: %1$s
You can leave the app while this runs. Return here to check progress.
An operation is already running, or history is still opening. Return Home to check its status.
The operation could not start. Your file choices are kept. Choose the destination again if needed, then re-enter your recovery number.
This result is no longer available. You can find recorded operations on Home or in Backups.
Your restored files were checked after saving. Open the new folder below.
Your encrypted backup was saved and checked by reading it back.
Some temporary or partial output could not be removed. Open the destination to check for unfinished files. See technical details for more information.
No additional details were recorded for this older operation.
The operation was stopped. You can start a fresh attempt with your saved file choices.
We could not unlock this backup. Check the recovery number or password. If it is correct, try another copy of the backup.
There was not enough temporary space on this phone. Free up storage or choose fewer files, then try again. Saving elsewhere does not remove the need for temporary phone storage.
A file or location could not be accessed. Reconnect its storage or choose it again to renew access.
The app stopped before this operation finished. It cannot resume automatically. Check the recorded location for partial output, then start a fresh attempt.
The files could not be read, saved, or verified. Check the selected storage and available space, then try again. Technical details may help identify the problem.
The system file picker could not open. Try again, or check that a Files app is available.
This location could not be opened. Use the system Files app to find it, or choose a new location.
An unused backup file could not be removed. Check the location you previously selected for an empty file.
Some temporary files could not be removed.
The backup result could not be added to the catalogue. The operation result is shown separately; keep track of its saved location.
File count unavailable for this older backup
Some selected files are no longer readable. Remove them or choose them again.
